correctness.rationale: The identity 8T(n)+1=(2n+1)^2 establishes odd-primary local roots; Hensel lifting handles even valuations and zero classes. For 2^a, the triangular congruence has two solutions mod 2^(a+1) per output, and the reflection n->2m-1-n halves the full 2m count. CRT gives the exact first m fiber product; local square counts give the image formula, including m=1 and powers of 2. An independent direct enumerator checked 45,150 (m,t) pairs for m<=300. No finite cutoff is used to prove the all-m statement.
